content_sections.heading: PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: PSS Central Institute of Vocational Education (PSSCIVE), under the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT), Ministry of Education, Government of India, has released the PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026 notification for the engagement of Assistant Professor, Senior Research Associate, Junior Project Fellow, Lab Assistant, Assistant Editor and D.T.P. Operator posts. A total of 11 posts have been advertised for contractual project staff, with selection through walk-in interviews scheduled on 30 September and 01 October 2026. content_sections.heading: PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview . For posts with a Ph.D. via the foreign-university route, an Academic Score table (Appendix II) is used only for short-listing candidates for the interview ; final selection is based solely on interview performance. For the D.T.P. Operator post, the schedule also includes a Skill Test (10:00 am-1:00 pm) before the interview (4:00 pm-5:00 pm) on 01.10.2026. The institute reserves the right to fill, partially fill, or not fill any advertised post based on candidate performance and suitability.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026 (Walk-in Interview)
content_sections.text: This is not an online-application recruitment . Based on the notification: Candidates should check the reporting time and interview time for their specific post in the Annexure-I schedule. Candidates must bring a filled application form with a recent passport-size photograph affixed. All original documents and a set of self-attested photocopies of certificates/marksheets must be produced at the time of interview - this is mandatory. Eligible and interested candidates should report at PSSCIVE, Shyamla Hills, Bhopal on the scheduled date and time. Candidates already employed must bring a Relieving Certificate at the time of joining. Candidates should also carry any relevant published/creative work (articles, books, research papers, design/media work, etc.) applicable to their post. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview or joining the post. A separate application must be filled for each post, if applying for more than one. The notification does not specify a prescribed application form link or an application start date - candidates are advised to check the official PSSCIVE website for the application format and any corrigendum.

faq.question: Q1. What is PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview drive (Advt 04/2026, dated 24.09.2026) by PSS Central Institute of Vocational Education, Bhopal, to engage 12 Project Staff on a contractual basis under various NCERT-approved projects.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification advertises 12 posts in total across Assistant Professor, Senior Research Associate, Junior Project Fellow, Lab Assistant, Assistant Editor, and D.T.P. Operator categories. (Note: the Junior Project Fellow post shows 01 vacancy in the main table but 02 in the Annexure-I schedule — this should be verified officially.)

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no "last date to apply" in the online sense, since this is a walk-in interview. Candidates must appear in person on 30 September 2026 or 1 October 2026, depending on their post, as per the Annexure-I schedule.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post - ranging from a Bachelor's degree (for Lab Assistant/DTP Operator) to a Master's degree with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. (for Assistant Professor posts). See the eligibility table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limits range from 40 to 45 years depending on the post (not specified for Assistant Professor posts), with relaxation as per Government of India norms. The cut-off date for age is 15.09.2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By attending the walk-in interview in person at PSSCIVE, Shyamla Hills, Bhopal, with a filled application form, passport-size photograph, and original/self-attested documents, on the date and time specified for your post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a walk-in interview (plus a skill test for the D.T.P. Operator post); for certain Ph.D. candidates, an academic score table is used only for interview short-listing.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for PSSCIVE Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Salaries range from Rs. 31,000/- to Rs. 56,000/- per month (consolidated), depending on the post. See the salary table above.
